en.headline: Alex Fong passes 14 km mark in Hong Kong to Macau charity swim
en.dek: The former Olympian started from Peaked Hill on Lantau at about 9 a.m. and had exited Hong Kong waters by early afternoon, aiming to finish the 35 km crossing in about nine hours.
body: Former Hong Kong Olympian and singer Alex Fong began a 35-kilometre open-water charity swim from Peaked Hill on Lantau Island to Hac Sa Beach in Macau at about 9 a.m. on Saturday, organisers said.

By around noon Fong had completed 12 kilometres and taken his first energy supplement, and by about 12.40 p.m. he had exited Hong Kong waters, according to reports from Hong Kong 01. Organisers said he had covered more than 14 kilometres by early afternoon and remained in good condition despite cold weather and moderate waves.

The swim is organised by the InspiringHK Sports Foundation under the title Legacy in the Waves. All funds raised, which organisers said had already exceeded HK$6 million by midday, will support sports programmes for underprivileged children and those with special educational needs in Hong Kong and Macau. The target is HK$10 million.

Fong, who previously completed a 45-kilometre circumnavigation of Hong Kong Island in 2019, is expected to take about nine hours. Marine Department Notice 222/2026 had advised vessels to exercise caution near the route between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. After landing in Macau he is due to appear at a charity concert the same evening.

zh.headline: 方力申港澳慈善游已完成逾14公里 游出香港水域
zh.dek: 前奧運泳手今早約九時由大嶼山雞翼角出發，中午已完成12公里並完成首次補給，下午初段已游出香港水域，目標約九小時橫渡35公里抵達澳門。
body: 前香港奧運泳手兼歌手方力申周六早上約九時由大嶼山雞翼角下水，展開35公里公開水域慈善游，終點為澳門黑沙海灘，主辦單位表示。
香港01報道，至中午約12時，方力申已完成12公里並完成第一次能量補給；約12時40分已游出香港水域。主辦單位指，下午初段他已游畢超過14公里，雖然天氣寒冷、海浪不輕，狀態仍然良好。
活動由凝動香港體育基金主辦，名為「凝動全城 破浪傳承」。主辦單位指，截至中午已籌得超過600萬港元，全數用於支持香港及澳門基層及有特殊教育需要兒童的體育項目，目標為1000萬港元。
方力申曾於2019年完成45公里香港環島泳。今次預計約九小時完成。海事處第222/2026號佈告已提醒船舶在上午九時至下午五時於有關航道附近小心航行。他預計傍晚在澳門上岸後，將出席當晚的慈善音樂會。
